text_block_list.text:
One holiday. I spotted Jungle Pocket 
wandering around town by herself.
Stop!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry for holding you back so 
suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
However... I'd like you to wait a little 
before talking to Pokke-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm deep in research right now. —On the 
secret behind Pokke-san's charisma!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
When people think of Pokke-san, they think 
of someone who captured the hearts of many 
and climbed all the way to the top of the 
team...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I can unravel the secret behind how she 
captivates everyone, it's bound to spark a 
paradigm shift in my self-branding!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san acting natural when she's all 
alone... I bet the secret's hiding right 
there. ...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Looks like they're moving. Let's go!

—And so, one thing led to another, and I 
ended up getting roped into Royce and 
Royce's “research”...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: 'Sup. How's business?

text_block_list.name: Clothing Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Pokke! As you can see. ...It's 
totally empty! Man, what should we do?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't get cold feet now. I'll 
hear ya out, so just take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friend
text_block_list.text: Huh! Pokke-san. 'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, long time no see! Man, I hear you've 
been doing crazy well lately.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I heard about it. You're having a solo 
graffiti exhibition? You, of all people, 
who used to tag all over our turf."

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"I was really sorry about what happened 
back then...! But that made me actually 
want to take art seriously! I'm seriously 
grateful to you, Pokke-san!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It starts from here, right? Your friends 
are rooting for you too, so give it your 
all!
choice_data_list: (Pokke really is... so bright, isn't she)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Pokke's gone...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —*Sigh*. I *knew* I was being followed.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Skulking around me without saying a 
word... Partner~ don't go letting me down 
now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Pokke! Actually, I—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Not talking to you. I'm asking them.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey... "Partner"? What was the point of 
tailing me?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Depending on the reason... Right!?

I've seen her intimidate others before... 
but she rarely ever directs it at me. It 
makes me flinch, but first...
choice_data_list:
Sorry if I made you uncomfortable! 
Actually—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, is that all? You should've just said 
so normally~.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry too! I was the one who asked to 
keep it quiet—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it. He's the one who 
drank it. He must've decided it wasn't for 
anything weird. So I don't care."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So, in the end! Did you figure out the 
secret to my... charisma thing?
choice_data_list:
How you're always so natural wherever you 
are.

The way she can see right to the essence 
of things

text_block_list.text:
The way she looked today, she was 
completely unpretentious, simply walking 
as she pleased. A calm, dignified 
presence, as if wherever she walked became 
her own path—
choice_data_list:
I think it's amazing how you can just be 
yourself like that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, around here is my turf anyway. No 
need for me to get all worked up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, I gotta introduce you to my pals 
around town too. There're still a bunch of 
folks I haven't told yet."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If people know you're my Trainer, well, it 
can't be all bad, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You come along too, Royce. You've got 
things you wanna ask me, right? I'll 
answer whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Only if you open up and speak honestly 
too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, this generosity and 
larger-than-life presence... So this is 
the secret behind her charisma. Taking 
notes, taking notes...

She is a girl who sees straight to the 
core of things. Even earlier, she probably 
knew there was a good reason and 
deliberately put on that menacing act.
choice_data_list: I was just teasing a little... right?
I was just teasing a little... wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"What would you do if I told you I'm 
actually furious?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha!! You're panicking way too much!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Course I was just messin' with ya! You 
gotta catch on, man!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't get legitimately pissed that 
easily. —Probably♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see... This bottomless depth must be the 
secret to her charisma. *Jotting this 
down...*
